update_binding: Change the Inbox link from {before} to {after}.
delete_binding: Remove the Inbox link {binding}. Other rules can take over, including automatic to-do creation.
set_policy: Replace the routing rule for {source}. Sources that inherit this rule will use the change for future updates.
off: Turn off automatic forwarding for this rule.
interval: Set the digest interval to {minutes} minutes.
owner: Allow the recipient to act on updates.
inherit_new_work: Inherit the rule for new work. Inherited and more specific rules can allow automatic to-do creation.
auto_todo: Allow Persona to create to-dos without asking each time.
ask_owner: Ask before creating a to-do at this scope. More specific rules can still allow automatic to-do creation.
